programs.title: Zillow Gone Wild
programs.desc: Jack McBrayer hunts for wildness in Florida and starts with a maritime-themed property with its own shark!; next, he heads to an estate honoring military flight and sees a storybook-shaped home.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: For three years, a couple has fought a tough market, and each other, to buy in their hometown of Berlin, Connecticut. She refuses to settle, and he refuses to spend, so it may take some hard truths to bring them together.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: A married couple's on the search for a character home they can make their own in Salt Lake City; both are okay with tackling a renovation, and he's looking for a bungalow that's close to the mountains; she prefers a midcentury fixer near downtown.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: After years of moving around for his medical training, a young doctor is ready to put down roots in Philadelphia, Penn.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.sub_title: Dreaming of a Chateau in DC
programs.desc: A couple has outgrown their rental, so they're on the hunt for their first home in the suburbs of Washington, DC; they agree that any place they choose has to work for their dog, but he wants something practical while she prefers chateau-style bling.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: With the help of an inheritance, a couple and their daughter search for a house upgrade to fit their extended family; David's tasked with finding a place big enough for a teenager, an adult son, and some pets in Santa Fe, New Mexico.
